resources.string: Each connection brings one child’s school events, school hours for the next four weeks and days without lessons into the family calendar. The phone talks to the school directly and updates once a day.
Connect your child’s Bakaláři account to see school events and school hours in the calendar.
The school asked for the password again
The phone forgets this sign-in and stops importing. Events already imported stay in the calendar.
The school asked for the password again.
The school’s server could not be reached. Try again later.
The school’s server answered with an error. Try again later.
Type the town your child’s school is in
The list of schools could not be loaded.
Keep typing to see more towns.
No schools are listed in this town.
The schools in this town could not be loaded.
The address of your school’s Bakaláři page, for example https://school.bakalari.cz
Enter an address that starts with https://.
No Bakaláři server answered at this address.
The password is used once to sign in and is never stored. The phone talks to the school directly.
The school’s server could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
The school’s server answered with an error. Try again later.
This account cannot see the timetable, so school hours and days without lessons will not be imported.
This account cannot see school events, so they will not be imported.
This account can see neither the timetable nor school events, so there is nothing to import. The school can turn them on.
This family has no child records yet. Add the child under Child information in Settings, then connect again.
School events for the child’s class, for the child and for the whole school, for the next 90 days
School hours of every school day in the next four weeks
Days without lessons, except holidays the calendar already shows
They become ordinary events of this family about %1$s, and your co-parent sees them too.
Grades, homework and individual lessons are not imported.
